description: This file contains unit tests for the DurableValue class, testing its basic operations, persistence, null handling, and support for complex types within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: DurableValueTests
classes.description: Unit test class for DurableValue, testing its functionality and resilience.

methods.name: DurableValue_BasicOperations_Test
methods.description: Tests setting and updating the value of DurableValue and ensuring journaled state persistence.

methods.name: DurableValue_Persistence_Test
methods.description: Verifies that DurableValue can persist and recover its stored value across system restarts.

methods.name: DurableValue_NullValue_Test
methods.description: Ensures DurableValue correctly handles null values, including setting and persistence.

methods.name: DurableValue_ComplexType_Test
